title: Setup
subtitle: A few steps to get your EasySend instance ready.
sessionExpired: The setup session expired. Enter the setup code again to continue; your progress is kept.
missing: Some required steps are not finished yet: {{steps}}. Complete them to continue.

code.title: Enter the setup code
code.intro: To make sure only you can configure this server, EasySend asks for a one-time code that it prints in its log.
code.whereLocal: Run this command in a terminal on this computer. You can also find it in the terminal where you started the app. The code is printed every time the API starts, until the setup is complete.
code.whereProduction: Run this command on the server, in the EasySend folder. The code is printed every time the API starts, until the setup is complete.
code.label: Setup code
code.format: Twelve letters and numbers, like XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
code.invalid: This code is not correct. Check the log and try again.
code.expired: This code has expired. A new one has just been printed in the API log: read it again and enter it here.

admin.title: Create the administrator account
admin.intro: This account manages users, settings and appearance. It is protected by two-factor authentication, which you will set up in the next step.
admin.displayNameHint: Shown to people who receive your transfers. Your email address is never shown.
admin.existsBody: An administrator account has already been created (for example with the command line), so this step is done. Continue with the email settings.
admin.enrollIntro: The administrator account always uses an authenticator app. The account is created only after you confirm the first code.
admin.enrollLost: The pending account was lost (for example the server restarted). Enter the details again.
admin.codesIntro: The administrator account has been created and you are signed in.

smtp.title: Email server
smtp.intro: EasySend sends emails to recipients, password resets and download notifications. Send a test email to confirm the settings work before saving.
smtp.localBody: The suggested values send emails to Mailpit, a mailbox that runs next to the app and never delivers anything outside your computer. You can use them as they are.
smtp.securityNoneHint: Only for local servers such as Mailpit.
smtp.passwordKept: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
smtp.testRequired: Send a test email with these settings to enable saving.
smtp.changedSinceTest: The settings changed after the last test. Send a new test email to enable saving.
smtp.testSentTo: It was sent to {{email}}. Check that it arrived, then save.
smtp.testRemembered: These settings passed a test a moment ago. You can save them.
smtp.testMailpit: In local mode you can read it in Mailpit at {{url}} (or the port set in MAILPIT_UI_PORT).
smtp.testFailed: The test email could not be sent.

reasons.ETIMEDOUT: the server did not answer in time
reasons.ECONNRESET: the connection was closed by the server
reasons.ESOCKET: connection or encryption error (check the encryption type and port)
reasons.ECONNECTION: could not connect to the server

cloudflare.title: Domain and Cloudflare tunnel
cloudflare.intro: EasySend is published through a Cloudflare Tunnel, so you do not need to open any port on your router. The domain must already be managed by Cloudflare.
cloudflare.tokenTitle: Create an API token with these permissions only
cloudflare.tokenNote: The token is used once, to create the tunnel and the DNS record. It is never saved.
cloudflare.domainHint: The domain managed by Cloudflare, for example example.com.
cloudflare.subdomainHint: Leave empty to use the domain itself; enter “files” to use files.example.com.
cloudflare.apiTokenHint: Paste the token you just created.
cloudflare.retryNote: Nothing was saved with the token. Fix the problem and try again.

hints.CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN_INVALID: Check that the token is active and has the three permissions listed above.
hints.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_NOT_FOUND: Check the spelling, and that the domain is added to the same Cloudflare account the token belongs to.
hints.CLOUDFLARE_RECORD_EXISTS: A DNS record with that name is already in use. Choose another subdomain or remove the old record in Cloudflare.
hints.CLOUDFLARE_API_ERROR: This is usually temporary. Wait a minute and try again.

cloudflare.doneHint: The tunnel can take a minute to connect. The site will be reachable at this address once the setup is complete.
cloudflare.skippedBody: You are running in local mode, so no domain or tunnel is needed. You can configure them later in Administration > Settings > Domain and tunnel.

general.title: General settings
general.intro: Sensible defaults are filled in. You can change all of these later in Administration > Settings.
general.instanceNameHint: Shown in the header, in the browser tab and in emails.
general.diskReserveHint: Uploads are refused when they would leave less free space than this. 1024 MB is a good start.
general.chunkSizeHint: Files are uploaded in pieces of this size. Cloudflare Free rejects any request above 100 MB, so use a value between 1 and {{max}}. {{default}} MB works well for most connections.
general.languageHint: Used for emails to recipients and for visitors who have not chosen a language.
general.themeHint: Each user can choose their own in their profile.

complete.title: Ready to finish
complete.intro: Here is what you have configured.
complete.afterwards: When you finish, the setup code stops working and the wizard is locked. Everything can be changed later from the administration area.
